import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle from matplotlib.font_manager import FontProperties
mpl.rcParams.update({ "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "font.size": 10, "text.color": "#263238", "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "svg.fonttype": "none", })
BLUE = "#33658A" TEAL = "#2A9D8F" TERRACOTTA = "#C66B4E" INK = "#263238"
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(9.6, 3.8), dpi=100) ax = fig.add_axes([0, 0, 1, 1]) ax.set_xlim(0, 960) ax.set_ylim(380, 0) ax.set_axis_off()
sans = FontProperties(family="DejaVu Sans") mono = FontProperties(family="DejaVu Sans Mono")
def text(x, y, s, size=10, color=INK, weight="normal", family="sans", ha="left", va="center"): return ax.text( x, y, s, fontsize=size, color=color, fontproperties=mono if family == "mono" else sans, fontweight=weight, ha=ha, va=va, )
# Panel headings and a single quiet divider. text(30, 30, "Memory Layout:", size=13, weight="bold") text(490, 30, "Core Butterfly Arithmetic Operations", size=13, weight="bold") ax.plot([457, 457], [24, 354], color="#E5EAE8", linewidth=0.9)
text(30, 65, "struct Complex { re: f64, im: f64 }", size=10.5, family="mono")
# Contiguous field diagram: two equal, adjacent 8-byte regions. x0, y0, field_w, field_h = 30, 118, 195, 70 ax.add_patch(Rectangle((x0, y0), field_w, field_h, facecolor=BLUE, edgecolor="none")) ax.add_patch(Rectangle((x0 + field_w, y0), field_w, field_h, facecolor=TEAL, edgecolor="none"))
text(30, 99, "Byte offset", size=8.5) for x, label in [(30, "0"), (225, "8"), (420, "16")]: text(x, 207, label, size=9, ha="center") ax.plot([x, x], [190, 195], color=INK, linewidth=0.7)
text(127.5, 141, "re: f64", size=12, color="white", family="mono", ha="center") text(127.5, 166, "real part · 64 bits", size=9, color="white", ha="center") text(322.5, 141, "im: f64", size=12, color="white", family="mono", ha="center") text(322.5, 166, "imaginary part · 64 bits", size=9, color="white", ha="center") text(225, 231, "16 bytes total · 8 bytes per field", size=9.5, ha="center")
# Unit-circle constructor, retaining the Rust field expressions. text(30, 272, "Unit-circle constructor", size=11, weight="bold") text(30, 302, "Complex::from_polar_unit(theta)", size=10, family="mono") text(30, 327, "-> { re: theta.cos(),", size=10, family="mono") text(30, 350, " im: theta.sin() }", size=10, family="mono")
# Arithmetic formulas are displayed as Rust-like scalar expressions. text(490, 77, "1 Addition (a + b)", size=11, weight="bold") text(508, 103, "re = a.re + b.re", family="mono") text(508, 125, "im = a.im + b.im", family="mono")
text(490, 162, "2 Subtraction (a - b)", size=11, weight="bold") text(508, 188, "re = a.re - b.re", family="mono") text(508, 210, "im = a.im - b.im", family="mono")
text(490, 247, "3 Multiplication (a * b)", size=11, weight="bold") text(508, 273, "(a.re + i a.im)(b.re + i b.im)", family="mono")
# Position separately colored tokens using the actual font metrics. fig.canvas.draw() renderer = fig.canvas.get_renderer() code_font = FontProperties(family="DejaVu Sans Mono", size=10)
def colored_code(x, y, segments): cursor = x for string, color in segments: text(cursor, y, string, family="mono", color=color) width, _, _ = renderer.get_text_width_height_descent( string, code_font, ismath=False ) cursor += width * 960 / fig.bbox.width
colored_code(508, 299, [ ("re = a.re * b.re ", INK), ("-", TERRACOTTA), (" a.im * b.im", INK), ]) text(508, 322, "im = a.re * b.im + a.im * b.re", family="mono") text(508, 350, r"Minus sign follows from $i^2 = -1$", size=9, color=TERRACOTTA)
